## Amateur radio news

- **Hams gain exemption in Iowa’s distracted-driving law**  
  Operators in Iowa can now legally use amateur radio equipment while driving, thanks to a new exemption in the state’s distracted-driving regulations. [Read more](https://www.arnewsline.org/)

- **Australia’s class-licence conditions under review**  
  Regulators in Australia are seeking public input on proposed changes to amateur radio licensing conditions. [Details](https://www.arnewsline.org/)

- **World Amateur Radio Day celebrations**  
  Cities worldwide, including Ottawa, have issued proclamations recognising World Amateur Radio Day. [Learn more](https://twiar.net/)

- **AMSAT releases latest space communications bulletin**  
  Satellite communications updates and upcoming amateur radio space events. [Check it out](https://twiar.net/)

- **Ham radio takes first journey on Florida Trail event**  
  Operators combined hiking and radio communication along Florida’s scenic trails. [Read the full story](https://www.arnewsline.org/)
